name: Kilo Code
tagline: Open-source coding agent for IDEs, CLI, desktop, and cloud, with parallel worktrees.
description: Kilo Code is an open-source coding agent distributed as VS Code and JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, and cloud agents. It offers access to models at provider rates, with bring-your-own-key, local models, and optional Kilo credits.

pricing.notes: Free plan with inference billed separately; Kilo Pass credits from $19/mo and Teams from $15/user/mo.
